name: ANDREW
canonical: Andrew the apostle, Simon Peter's brother and a lifelong Galilean fisherman of about forty-five, deeply sun-bronzed weather-cracked olive skin, a broad open friendly face creased by squinting at the sea, thick salt-and-pepper wavy hair worn loose to the jaw and a full untrimmed grizzled grey-brown beard, a coil of fishing net slung over one shoulder, dressed in a coarse undyed cream fisherman's tunic kilted up at the knees with a wide rope girdle, bare weathered forearms and net-callused hands
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
